items.claim: Michael Oliveira has evolved to take his time and slowly break opponents rather than just getting quick early knockouts.
items.quote: Now he's kind of doing the thing where it's like taking his time a little bit, slowly, you know, breaking his opponents

items.claim: Obon Elliott will not be able to secure a takedown against Michael Oliveira.
items.quote: You're not going to take down this guy. You're not going to take down Michael Oliveira.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira has extremely high grappling durability likened to a brick wall.
items.quote: this guy is made out of brick. Have you ever tried to take down a brick wall?

items.claim: Nina Milosevic possesses good striking with fast, accurate hands and power.
items.quote: She's good. She has good striking, fast, accurate hands. She has some pop on those hands as well.

items.claim: Nina Milosevic is a very good grappler and wrestler who excels at opportunistic submissions and taking dominant positions.
items.quote: She's a very good grappler, good wrestler, opportunistic submissions. She's very good at getting, you know, into dominant positions

items.claim: Hailey Cowan is on a three-fight skid and is 0 and 3 in the UFC.
items.quote: She's on a three-fight skin. She's 0 and 3 in the UFC.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad is a BJJ black belt.
Bogdan Grad throws high volume and lands bigger shots.
items.quote: Bogdan Grad, he's going to throw a lot of volume... He's going to be landing the bigger shots. He's going to be throwing more.
